Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: vaakapylväät näyt: Graph to scale: horizontal bars show how much energy a device transforms in one second. A kettle with a power of 2000 W transforms 2000 J, a toaster of 1000 W transforms 1000 J and a television of 100 W only 100 J. The length of a bar is directly proportional to the power.
Kuvaaja: energia ajan funktiona kolmelle: Graph: energy as a function of time for three devices that transform energy steadily. The 2000 W line of the kettle rises most steeply, the 1000 W line of the toaster half as gently and the 80 W line of the television almost horizontally. The slope of a line is the power: on the kettle's line 40 kJ is used in 20 seconds. The scales are evenly spaced and the graph is to scale.
